title: Effect cleanup
source: Effect cleanup removes the previous event listener before the effect runs again. This prevents duplicate listeners.
question: Why does cleanup matter?

rationale: Clearing the old listener before rerun paraphrases removal and duplicate prevention.

title: Memo
source: React.memo can skip a component render when its props are unchanged. Local state changes can still cause the component to render.
question: When can React.memo help?
learner: If the props stay the same, memo may save a render, but changing local state can still make it render.
rationale: Both conditional render skipping and the local-state exception are explicit.
